title: Cardinal DriveSense Bonus on Deductible Rewards Claim-Free Credit
content:
**Program term.** A vehicle enrolled in Cardinal DriveSense earns a bonus on its Deductible Rewards claim-free credit under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage. Where the vehicle's DriveSense enrollment is scored with a final score of 90 or higher, 50 is added; where it is scored with a final score of at least 75 but below 90, 25 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The bonus is added to the annual credit, and it is that sum which is reduced to the room left under the credit cap.

The enrollment status and final score are read from the vehicle's Cardinal DriveSense enrollment record.

| Cardinal DriveSense enrollment status | Final score | Bonus (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Scored | 90 or higher | 50 |
| Scored | 75 to below 90 | 25 |
| Scored | Below 75 | 0 |
| Enrolled, observing, opted out or terminated | Any | 0 |
| No enrollment on the vehicle | — | 0 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical scores)

- Scored, final score 90: 50. Final score 89: 25.
- Scored, final score 75: 25. Final score 74: 0.
- An enrollment still observing: 0, whatever score it shows, because the enrollment is not scored.
- An annual credit of 100 with a bonus of 50 gives 150, before the room under the credit cap is applied; with room of 120.00 the credit granted is 120.00.
